answer: The wander is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the vault. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, held in escrow until finality, each submission carries a fresh nonce. What survives to the haven is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
